name: 63102 · Saint Louis, MO
findings: ZIP 63102 (Saint Louis) has 112 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 63102 (Saint Louis) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
52% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 63102 (Saint Louis) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 9.4 times the typical level).
